What this pilot proves

This version demonstrates the experience you described: one map, not two separate pictures. Each hole now has a single view combining the dynamic pin location with the hole's slope/heat personality. The remaining limitation is calibration: the slope layer is still a visual interpretation, not a surveyed DEM.
